层次与深度
Elevated
深度通过 Elevated、边框对比以及可复用的阴影或模糊处理来传达。请在主视觉面板、卡片与控件间保持这些配方一致，使页面读起来像同一套材质体系。
表面应优先呈现 Elevated 质感，边框、阴影与模糊仅用于强化这一材质选择。
技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 1px padding and a 19px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(rgba(64, 64, 64, 0.4), rgba(38, 38, 38, 0.2), rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.4)) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• 间距需对齐检测到的 4px 节奏。
• reuse the Elevated surface treatment consistently across cards and controls.
• keep corner radii within the detected 18px, 19px, 9999px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 不要exceed the detected moderate motion intensity without a deliberate reason.
动效
动效克制且以界面为主导，贯穿文字、布局与区块过渡。 时序主要聚集在 3000ms 与 300ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。 悬停行为侧重 Shadow 与 变换 变化。 滚动编排采用 视差 与 GSAP ScrollTrigger 控制区块显现与节奏。

WebGL
WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a inset canvas accent using webgl, DPR 限制, custom shaders. The effect should read as technical, meditative, and atmospheric: dot-matrix particle field with orange on black and dense spacing. Build it from dot particles + soft depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve reduced motion + dom fallback.
